Comparison between athal and psun

```{r make data, echo=FALSE}

  psun = read.csv("expression/psun.csv")
  ovis = read.csv("expression/ovis.csv")
  athal = read.csv("expression/athal.csv")
  cjap = read.csv("expression/cjap.csv")
  n2a = read.csv("expression/n2a.csv")
  
  sampleTable <- read.csv("expression/sampletree.csv", row.names = 1)
  
  
test <- read.delim(file='Orthogroups.tsv')

ogs <- melt(test, id = "Orthogroup")

ogs$value <- tolower(ogs$value)

ogs <- ogs |>
  separate_rows(value, sep = ", ")

colnames(ogs) <- c("Family", "Species", "Gene")

psun$X <- tolower(psun$X)
psun <- psun %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(psun) <- psun$X
psun <- psun[,-1]

ovis$X <- tolower(ovis$X)
ovis <- ovis %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(ovis) <- ovis$X
ovis <- ovis[,-1]

cjap$X <- tolower(cjap$X)
cjap <- cjap %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(cjap) <- cjap$X
cjap <- cjap[,-1]

athal$X <- tolower(athal$X)
athal <- athal %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(athal) <- athal$X
athal <- athal[,-1]

n2a$X <- tolower(n2a$X)
n2a <- n2a %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))%>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(n2a) <- n2a$X
n2a <- n2a[,-1]


ogs <- ogs |>
  mutate(Gene = trimws(Gene)) |>
  filter(Gene != "")

explist <- list(psun = psun, ovis = ovis, cjap = cjap, n2a = n2a, athal = athal)

exp_ortho <- exp_genes2orthogroups(explist, ogs, summarize = "median")

```

```{r Processing, echo=FALSE}

list2env(exp_ortho,envir=.GlobalEnv)

psun$rn <- rownames(psun)
ovis$rn <- rownames(ovis)
athal$rn <- rownames(athal)
cjap$rn <- rownames(cjap)
n2a$rn <- rownames(n2a)


expr <- full_join(psun, cjap)
expr <- full_join(expr, ovis)
expr <- full_join(expr, n2a)
expr <- full_join(expr, athal)

rownames(expr) <- expr$rn
expr$rn <- NULL

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr)
storage.mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

rownames(sampleTable) == colnames(expr_mat)

rowData <- DataFrame(Orthogroup = rownames(expr_mat))
rownames(rowData) <- rownames(expr_mat)

rownames(sampleTable) == colnames(expr_mat)

colData <- DataFrame(Species = sub(".*_", "", colnames(expr_mat)))
rownames(colData) <- colnames(expr_mat)

se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(expr = expr_mat),
  rowData = rowData,
  colData = colData
)

se

```


```{r Gene co-expression inference, echo=FALSE}

final_exp <- exp_preprocess(
    se, min_exp = 10, variance_filter = TRUE, n = 2000
)

final_exp

p <- plot_heatmap(final_exp, type = "samplecor", show_rownames = FALSE)
p

plot_PCA(final_exp)

```


```{r Threshholding, echo=FALSE}
sft <- SFT_fit(final_exp, net_type = "signed hybrid", cor_method = "pearson")

sft$power

power <- sft$power

sft$plot


net <- exp2gcn(
    final_exp, net_type = "signed hybrid", SFTpower = power, 
    cor_method = "pearson"
)

names(net)

plot_dendro_and_colors(net)

plot_eigengene_network(net)

plot_ngenes_per_module(net)

```
```{r Module Trait Association, echo=FALSE}

MEtrait <- module_trait_cor(exp = final_exp, MEs = net$MEs)
head(MEtrait)

plot_module_trait_cor(MEtrait)

plot_expression_profile(
    exp = final_exp, 
    net = net, 
    plot_module = TRUE, 
    modulename = "pink"
)

```

```{r save module, echo=FALSE}


modules <- net[["genes_and_modules"]]


#modules <- modules[modules$Modules == "pink",]

names(modules)[1]<-paste("Family")

geneModules <- inner_join(ogs, modules)

write.csv(geneModules, "geneModules.csv")

```


```{r species conservation, echo=FALSE}


species <- colData(se)$Species


expr <- assay(se)

# keep most variable genes only
rv <- rowVars(expr, na.rm = TRUE)

keep <- rv > quantile(rv, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)

expr <- expr[keep, ]
se <- se[keep, ]

enableWGCNAThreads(nThreads = parallel::detectCores() - 4)

allowWGCNAThreads()

blas_set_num_threads(parallel::detectCores() - 4)
omp_set_num_threads(parallel::detectCores() - 4)


keep_by_species <- lapply(se_list, function(se_sp) {
  rowSums(!is.na(assay(se_sp))) >= 5
})

keep <- Reduce(`&`, keep_by_species)

se_list2 <- lapply(se_list, function(se_sp) se_sp[keep, ])


se_list2 <- lapply(split(seq_len(ncol(se)), species), function(idx) {
  se[, idx]
})


cons_sft <- consensus_SFT_fit(se_list2, setLabels = names(se_list2),
                              cor_method = "pearson")


powers <- cons_sft$power
powers

power <- max(cons_sft$power)

cons_sft$plot 
  scale_color_viridis_d()

consensus <- consensus_modules(se_list2, power = power, cor_method = "pearson", verbose = TRUE)

names(consensus)

head(consensus$genes_cmodules)


ortho_exp <- lapply(exp_ortho, exp_preprocess, variance_filter=TRUE, n=6000)

sapply(ortho_exp, nrow)

power_ortho <- lapply(ortho_exp, SFT_fit, cor_method="pearson")

gcns <- lapply(seq_along(power_ortho), function(n) 
  exp2gcn(ortho_exp[[n]], SFTpower = power_ortho[[n]]$power, net_type = "signed hybrid", 
          cor_method = "pearson"
)
  )


length(gcns)

pres_all <- lapply(seq_along(gcns), function(i) {
  lapply(seq_along(gcns), function(j) {
    if (i == j) return(NULL)

    module_preservation(
      ortho_exp[c(i, j)],
      ref_net  = gcns[[j]],
      test_net = gcns[[j]],
      algorithm = "netrep"
    )
  })
})

names(pres_all) <- names(gcns)


```
